name: Air Jordan 11 Retro Low 'Bred' 2025
story_html: The 2025 edition of the Air Jordan 11 Retro Low 'Bred' carries a black ballistic mesh upper with a tonal patent leather mudguard. A small Jumpman logo adorns the black leather back tab, while 'Jumpman' and 'Jordan' are inscribed in stylized lettering across the tongue. Augmented with full-length Air-sole cushioning, a white Phylon midsole is supported by a red translucent rubber outsole and a carbon fiber spring plate.
